description: The published advisory dataset behind the MCP Version-Safety Check: every advisory on file for the four covered official MCP reference servers (git, filesystem, everything, fetch), with GHSA ids, affected version ranges, fixed versions and source releases, plus the published residual gaps and the dataset date. Every verdict the paid check returns is reproducible from this dataset. — no payment required: call directly without payment (no x402 challenge; this tool is free). HTTP equivalent: GET https://exchangerebel.com/toll/mcp-version-safety/advisories.
name: mcp_version_advisories
